name: Build Cybersecurity Awareness Bot

on:
  push:
    branches: [ main ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ main ]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up .NET
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: '8.0.x'

      - name: Locate WPF project
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $project = Get-ChildItem -Recurse -Filter *.csproj |
            Where-Object { $_.FullName -match 'CybersecurityAwarenessBot\.GUI' } |
            Select-Object -First 1

          if (-not $project) {
            throw "WPF GUI project file was not found."
          }

          "PROJECT_PATH=$($project.FullName)" >> $env:GITHUB_ENV

      - name: Build WPF project
        run: dotnet build "$env:PROJECT_PATH" --configuration Release
